 Welcome to Best Western on the Beach 
 GULF SHORES ALABAMA
 
 
 
 
 

 Welcome to the only major-chain beachfront hotel in the Gulf Shores, Alabama. Located on the white-sand shores of one of America’s most beautiful beaches, 
 the Best Western on the Beach is your tropical vacation destination, offering all the comforts of home with exceptional value for your dollar.

 
 Breathtaking Beachfront Views
 Marvel at uninterrupted views of the Gulf of Mexico from your private balcony. Relax on a plush, pillow-top bed. Stay connected with free high-speed wireless Internet. 
 Catch a flick on a 42” flatscreen TV. At the Best Western on the Beach, our clean, modern Gulf Shores accommodations offer all the 
 comforts of home and all the beauty of the beach at rates that will leave you with plenty to spend on the area’s world-class attractions. 
 

 
 View Rooms

 View Amenities

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 Guest Reviews 

 Best Western On The Beach Recent Traveler Reviews “Love love love this place” “Never returning and wouldn’t recommend to others.” “Cleanest hotel I've ever stayed at!!!” Read reviews Write a review 

 
 
 VIEW MORE REVIEWS
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
Onsite Restaurant, Pool, and More 
Our convenient onsite amenities and services offer a complete vacation experience. Start your day with the 
best breakfast in Gulf Shores at our onsite Island Pancake House. Soak up the sun in our outdoor pool, cool off 
in our indoor pool, or relax in our hot tub. Host your wedding or special event on our spacious beachfront or in our 50-person meeting 
facility. All the while, you can stay connected with free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. 

Your Gateway to Gulf Shores
 Our hotel’s location puts you within walking distance some the most popular things to do in Gulf Shores 
 including top-tier restaurants, fishing charters, and outdoor adventures. Within easy driving distance, 
you’ll find a dozen award-winning golf courses, a world-class zoo, five-star spas and much more. 

Book Online and Save
To make the most of your Gulf Shores vacation, take advantage of our exclusive Gulf Shores hotel packages. 
When you’re ready to make reservations, book online for secure service with our best rates. We look forward to 
making your Gulf Shores vacation unforgettable!

 Annual Events 

 There’s always something exciting happening in Gulf Shores, Alabama, from festivals and tournaments, to concerts and more. 
 Some of the most popular annual attractions include:

 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 Orange Beach Festival of Art 

 
 
 
 

 

 
 Located just a few minutes from Gulf Shores, the city of Orange Beach is host to a long-running festival of art, which 
 showcases both established and up-and-coming local artists. Don’t miss the chance to get your hands on an original piece or 
 simply browse the art, chat with artists and enjoy the great food and music. 
 

 
 

 

 
 Mullet Toss | April 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 This annual beach party is well worth the drive to nearby Pensacola, FL for a weekend of fun in the sun with thousands of other beachgoers. The main event is a 
 competition to see who can throw a dead mullet (the fish, not the hairstyle) farthest over the Alabama-Florida state line, but there’s much more to see and do 
 including live music, great food and beachfront shopping.
 

 

 
 
 Hangout Music Festival | May

 
 
 
 
 
 More than 35,000 music fans make their way to Gulf Shores every year for this one-of-a-kind music festival held right on the beach. It features an average of 70 
 bands, along with a variety of fun-in-the-sun activities. 

 
 

 

 

 
 

 
 Thunder on the Beach | August 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 Happening every August in nearby Orange Beach, AL, this exhilarating powerboat racing event offers fun and excitement for the whole family. In addition to the 
 races the event features a bikini contest, poker tournament, motorcycle run and lots of live music and entertainment. 
 

 
 

 

 
 National Shrimp Festival | October
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 As one of the nation’s premier outdoor festivals, the National Shrimp Fest features much more than just shrimp. With great live entertainment and over 300 vendors selling 
 practically everything under the sun, the festival attracts more than a quarter-million people to the beaches of Gulf Shores every October.

distinctive and delicious flavors like chocolate chip and cheesecake. It’s also a great spot to grab a burger, sandwich or classic
 breakfast. And did we mention the breathtaking view? Make it a breakfast to remember at Island Pancake House!

 Welcome to Gulf Shores, Alabama
For generations, vacationers seeking an escape from the grind of everyday life have come to relax on the sugary white-sand beaches of 
Gulf Shores. Our costal city is located at the southernmost tip of the state of Alabama and blessed with some of America’s most idyllic 
coastline, overlooking the wide expanse of the Gulf of Mexico.

 

 While the beach is Gulf Shores’ main attraction, it’s far from the only one. Everyone from retirees to spring breakers find 
 countless fun and exciting things to do in Gulf Shores, Alabama, including first-rate seafood dining, a world-class zoo and some 
 of the best golfing in the state.
 
 

 Our Hotel’s Location 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Best Western on the Beach is the only true hotel on the beach in Gulf Shores. Our beachfront property offers incredible views and direct access to one of the city’s 
 most spectacular stretches of coastline. It’s less than a mile walk to the Gulf State Park Pier, the longest pier on the Gulf of Mexico. Within easy walking distance 
 of our front door, you’ll find dozens of restaurants, boutiques and attractions.
